047/**
048 * {@link McpRevision} implementation for MCP revision {@code 2025-06-18}.
049 *
050 * <p>
051 * Owns this revision's JSON-RPC method table and error-code table. Note the error-code table
052 * deliberately reproduces a known-wrong mapping: {@link McpErrorKind#UNKNOWN_METHOD},
053 * {@link McpErrorKind#TOOL_NOT_FOUND} and {@link McpErrorKind#PROMPT_NOT_FOUND} all report
054 * {@code -32601}, which is only actually correct for the first. Preserving that is intentional —
055 * the corrective fix for those two is tracked separately and is not part of this re-layering.
056 * {@link McpErrorKind#RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND} is not part of that known-wrong grouping: it correctly
057 * reports {@code -32002}, the {@code 2025-06-18} spec's dedicated missing-resource error code.
058 *
059 * <p>
060 * <b>Constructed per binding, not shared as a singleton (Correction C8).</b> The bound servlet or
061 * mixin builds a fresh instance on every {@code revision()} call, passing its own
062 * {@code capabilities()} hook result into the constructor — see {@link McpRestServlet} and
063 * {@link McpEndpoint}. That is how this revision learns which explicit capabilities (if any)
064 * to advertise, with no channel back into core: this class is otherwise entirely stateless, so
065 * constructing a new one per call costs nothing.
066 */
067@SuppressWarnings({
068   "java:S2176" // Settled, intentional name shadow against the neutral org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpRevision SPI
069                // (evaluated and rejected renaming this to e.g. AbstractMcpRevision): every dated adapter binding
070                // class is deliberately de-versioned to plain "McpRevision" and differentiated from its siblings only by
071                // package, matching the revision-string-free naming already used throughout each vNNNNNNNN module.
072})
073public final class McpRevision implements org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpRevision {
074

082    */
083   public McpRevision(ServerCapabilities capabilities) {
084      this.capabilities = capabilities;
085   }

108   private static final String PARAM_ARGUMENTS = "arguments";
109
110   private static final Set<String> SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS =
111      Set.of("type", "properties", "required", "additionalProperties", "items", "$defs");
112
113   private static final Set<McpServerConfig> VALIDATED =
114      Collections.synchronizedSet(Collections.newSetFromMap(new WeakHashMap<>()));
115
116   /**
117    * Verifies that every registered tool's input <em>and</em> output schema is expressible in this
118    * revision's wire schema type.
119    *
120    * <p>
121    * The neutral {@link McpSchema} is an unconstrained JSON object carrier, but this revision's
122    * {@code JsonSchema} bean supports exactly six keywords and models only object schemas. Each
123    * schema role is therefore checked twice: its root must declare {@code "type":"object"}, and the
124    * complete graph reachable from that root may use only this revision's six keywords. Rather than
125    * silently dropping an unsupported keyword — or an incompatible root shape — on the wire, a config
126    * carrying one is rejected, naming the tool, the offending role ({@code inputSchema} /
127    * {@code outputSchema}), and the offending shape or keyword.
128    *
129    * <p>
130    * Before walking, each schema is passed through {@link JsonValueSafety} to bound nesting depth,
131    * node count, and cyclic/shared references, so a pathological config cannot stall or exhaust the
132    * walk. The wall-clock deadline is not applied: the schemas are server-authored and the node bound
133    * already limits the work, so a slow walk (a loaded CI host, a GC pause) must not reject a valid
134    * config.
135    *
136    * <p>
137    * Note this cannot be a complete guarantee against every possible wire shape: {@code JsonSchema}
138    * is {@code public} and non-{@code final}, and Juneau's reflection-based marshalling will
139    * serialize a getter added by a subclass. No such subclass exists in this codebase, and none can
140    * be constructed through the public MCP API, but the check covers what a caller can express
141    * through {@link McpSchema}, not what reflection can reach.
142    *
143    * @param config The config to validate. Never {@code null}.
144    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If any tool's input or output schema has a non-object root or uses an unsupported keyword.
145    */
146   public static void validateSchemas(McpServerConfig config) {
147      config.getTools().forEach(handler -> {
148         var spec = handler.descriptor();
149         if (spec != null) {
150            validateSchema(spec.getName(), "inputSchema", spec.getInputSchema());
151            validateSchema(spec.getName(), "outputSchema", spec.getOutputSchema());
152         }
153      });
154   }
155
156   private static void validateSchema(String toolName, String role, McpSchema schema) {
157      if (schema == null)
158         return;
159      var raw = schema.toJsonMap();
160      // No deadline: a server-authored schema must not fail validation because the host is slow.
161      JsonValueSafety.check(raw, "Tool '" + toolName + "' " + role + " for MCP revision 2025-06-18", JsonValueSafety.NO_DEADLINE);
162      if (neq(raw.get("type"), "object"))
163         throw iaex("Tool ''%s'' %s root type ''%s'' is not object; MCP revision 2025-06-18 requires object schemas.",
164            toolName, role, raw.get("type"));
165      checkKeywords(toolName, role, raw);
166   }
167
168   @SuppressWarnings({
169      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for an explicit-stack JSON-schema tree walk; splitting the per-shape branches would fragment a single cohesive traversal.
170   })
171   private static void checkKeywords(String toolName, String role, Object root) {
172      var seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<Object,Boolean>());
173      var stack = new ArrayDeque<SchemaValue>();
174      stack.push(new SchemaValue(root));
175      while (! stack.isEmpty()) {
176         var framed = stack.pop();
177         var value = framed.value();
178         if ((value instanceof Map<?,?> || value instanceof Collection<?> || value != null && value.getClass().isArray())
179            && ! seen.add(value))
180            continue;
181         if (value instanceof Map<?,?> value2) {
182            for (var entry : value2.entrySet()) {
183               var keyword = String.valueOf(entry.getKey());
184               if (! SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS.contains(keyword))
185                  throw iaex("Tool ''%s'' %s declares JSON Schema keyword ''%s'', which MCP revision 2025-06-18 cannot represent.",
186                     toolName, role, keyword);
187               var child = entry.getValue();
188               if ((eqa(keyword, "properties", "$defs")) && child instanceof Map<?,?> child2) {
189                  for (var schema : child2.values())
190                     stack.push(new SchemaValue(schema));
191               } else {
192                  stack.push(new SchemaValue(child));
193               }
194            }
195         } else if (value instanceof Collection<?> value2)
196            value2.forEach(child -> stack.push(new SchemaValue(child)));
197         else if (value != null && value.getClass().isArray())
198            for (var i = 0; i < Array.getLength(value); i++)
199               stack.push(new SchemaValue(Array.get(value, i)));
200      }
201   }
202
203   private record SchemaValue(Object value) {}
204
205   @Override /* McpRevision */
206   public String protocolVersion() {
207      return McpProtocol.VERSION_2025_06_18;
208   }
209
210   @Override /* McpRevision */
211   public int errorCode(McpErrorKind kind) {
212      return switch (kind) {
213         case INVALID_REQUEST -> CODE_INVALID_REQUEST;
214         case UNKNOWN_METHOD, TOOL_NOT_FOUND, PROMPT_NOT_FOUND -> CODE_METHOD_NOT_FOUND;
215         case RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND -> CODE_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND;
216         case INVALID_PARAMS -> CODE_INVALID_PARAMS;
217         case INTERNAL_ERROR -> CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR;
218         case PARSE_ERROR -> CODE_PARSE_ERROR;
219      };
220   }
221
222   @Override /* McpRevision */
223   public McpDispatchResult dispatch(McpExchange exchange, McpServerConfig config, BeanStore ctx) {
224      var response = dispatchResponse(exchange, config, ctx);
225      return response == null ? null : new McpResponseResult(response);
226   }
227
228   /**
229    * Does the actual dispatch work. This revision never streams, so every non-notification outcome is a
230    * single {@link JsonRpcResponse}; {@link #dispatch} wraps it in a {@link McpResponseResult}.
231    */
232   private JsonRpcResponse dispatchResponse(McpExchange exchange, McpServerConfig config, BeanStore ctx) {
233      reqnn("exchange", exchange);
234      reqnn("config", config);
235      reqnn("ctx", ctx);
236
237      if (! VALIDATED.contains(config)) {
238         validateSchemas(config);
239         VALIDATED.add(config); // Only after success, so a bad config keeps failing on every request.
240      }
241
242      var req = exchange.request();
243      if (req == null)
244         return JsonRpcResponse.errorResponse(null, errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_REQUEST), "Request envelope is null");
245
246      var id = req.getId();
247      var method = req.getMethod();
248
249      if (isEmpty(method))
250         return JsonRpcResponse.notification(id) ? null
251            : JsonRpcResponse.errorResponse(id, errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_REQUEST), "Missing method");
252
253      try {
254         var result = invoke(method, req.getParams(), config, ctx);
255         return JsonRpcResponse.notification(id) ? null : JsonRpcResponse.ok(id, result);
256      } catch (McpException e) {
257         return JsonRpcResponse.notification(id) ? null : new JsonRpcResponse()
258            .setJsonrpc(McpProtocol.JSON_RPC_2_0)
259            .setId(id)
260            .setError(e.toJsonRpcError());
261      } catch (Exception e) {
262         if (JsonRpcResponse.notification(id))
263            return null;
264         var message = e.getMessage() == null ? cns(e) : e.getMessage();
265         return JsonRpcResponse.errorResponse(id, errorCode(McpErrorKind.INTERNAL_ERROR), message, JsonMap.of("type", cn(e)));
266      }
267   }
268
269   private Object invoke(String method, Object params, McpServerConfig config, BeanStore ctx) {
270      switch (method) {
271         case McpMethods.INITIALIZE:
272            return initialize(config);
273         case McpMethods.PING:
274            return new JsonMap();
275         case McpMethods.TOOLS_LIST:
276            return listTools(config, params, ctx);
277         case McpMethods.TOOLS_CALL:
278            return callTool(config, params, ctx);
279         case McpMethods.PROMPTS_LIST:
280            return listPrompts(config, params, ctx);
281         case McpMethods.PROMPTS_GET:
282            return getPrompt(config, params, ctx);
283         case McpMethods.RESOURCES_LIST:
284            return listResources(config, params, ctx);
285         case McpMethods.RESOURCES_READ:
286            return readResource(config, params, ctx);
287         case McpMethods.RESOURCES_TEMPLATES_LIST:
288            return listResourceTemplates(config, params, ctx);
289         case McpMethods.COMPLETION_COMPLETE:
290            return complete(config, params, ctx);
291         default:
292            throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.UNKNOWN_METHOD), "Method not found: " + method);
293      }
294   }
295
296   private InitializeResult initialize(McpServerConfig config) {
297      var caps = this.capabilities;
298      if (caps == null) {
299         caps = new ServerCapabilities();
300         if (! config.getTools().isEmpty())
301            caps.setTools(new ToolCapability());
302         if (! config.getPrompts().isEmpty())
303            caps.setPrompts(new PromptCapability());
304         if (! config.getResources().isEmpty() || ! config.getResourceTemplates().isEmpty())
305            caps.setResources(new ResourceCapability());
306         if (config.hasAnyCompleter())
307            caps.setCompletions(new CompletionCapability());
308      }
309      return new InitializeResult()
310         .setProtocolVersion(protocolVersion())
311         .setCapabilities(caps)
312         .setServerInfo(McpWire.serverInfo(config))
313         .setInstructions(config.getInstructions());
314   }
315
316   private static ListToolsResult listTools(McpServerConfig config, Object params, BeanStore ctx) {
317      var descriptors = config.getTools().stream().map(McpToolHandler::descriptor).toList();
318      var page = config.getCursor().page(descriptors, McpCursor.cursorOf(params), ctx);
319      return new ListToolsResult()
320         .setTools(page.items().stream().map(McpWire::toWire).toList())
321         .setNextCursor(page.nextCursor());
322   }
323
324   private CallToolResult callTool(McpServerConfig config, Object params, BeanStore ctx) {
325      var p = McpParamUtils.asMap(params);
326      var name = McpParamUtils.strParam(p, "name");
327      if (name == null)
328         throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_PARAMS), "Missing tool name");
329      var handler = config.getTools().stream()
330         .filter(h -> name.equals(h.descriptor().getName()))
331         .findFirst()
332         .orElseThrow(() -> new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.TOOL_NOT_FOUND), "Tool not found: " + name));
333      var args = McpParamUtils.mapParam(p, PARAM_ARGUMENTS);
334      var outcome = handler.call(args, ctx);
335      validateStructuredOutput(outcome);
336      return McpWire.toWire(outcome);
337   }
338
339   private static void validateStructuredOutput(McpToolOutcome outcome) {
340      if (outcome == null || outcome.getStructuredContent() == null)
341         return;
342      if (! (outcome.getStructuredContent() instanceof Map<?,?>))
343         throw new McpException(CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR,
344            "Tool structuredContent must be a JSON object for MCP revision 2025-06-18");
345      try {
346         // No deadline: the node bound caps the walk, and a slow host must not fail a valid result.
347         JsonValueSafety.check(outcome.getStructuredContent(), "Tool structuredContent", JsonValueSafety.NO_DEADLINE);
348      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
349         throw new McpException(CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR, e.getMessage());
350      }
351   }

382   private ReadResourceResult readResource(McpServerConfig config, Object params, BeanStore ctx) {
383      var p = McpParamUtils.asMap(params);
384      var uri = McpParamUtils.strParam(p, "uri");
385      if (uri == null)
386         throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_PARAMS), "Missing resource uri");
387      var exact = config.getResources().stream()
388         .filter(h -> uri.equals(h.descriptor().getUri()))
389         .findFirst();
390      if (exact.isPresent())
391         return McpWire.toWire(exact.get().read(uri, ctx));
392      var match = config.resolveResourceTemplate(uri);
393      var outcome = match == null ? null : match.handler().read(uri, match.variables(), ctx);
394      if (outcome == null)
395         throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND), "Resource not found: " + uri);
396      return McpWire.toWire(outcome);
397   }

407   private CompleteResult complete(McpServerConfig config, Object params, BeanStore ctx) {
408      var p = McpParamUtils.asMap(params);
409      var ref = completionRef(McpParamUtils.mapParam(p, "ref"));
410      var argument = McpParamUtils.mapParam(p, "argument");
411      var argumentName = McpParamUtils.strParam(argument, "name");
412      if (isEmpty(argumentName))
413         throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_PARAMS), "Missing argument.name");
414      var value = McpParamUtils.strictStrParam(argument, "value");
415      if (value == null)
416         throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_PARAMS), "Missing or non-string argument.value");
417      var contextArguments = McpParamUtils.strictStrMapParam(McpParamUtils.mapParam(p, "context"), PARAM_ARGUMENTS);
418
419      var completer = config.completer(ref, argumentName);
420      McpCompletionResult raw;
421      if (completer == null) {
422         raw = McpCompletionResult.empty();
423      } else {
424         var request = new McpCompletionRequest()
425            .setRef(ref)
426            .setArgumentName(argumentName)
427            .setValue(value)
428            .setContextArguments(contextArguments);
429         raw = completer.complete(request, ctx);
430      }
431      return McpWire.toWire(McpCompletionResult.normalize(raw));
432   }
433
434   private McpCompletionRef completionRef(Map<String,Object> refMap) {
435      var type = McpParamUtils.strParam(refMap, "type");
436      if (eq(type, "ref/prompt")) {
437         var name = McpParamUtils.strParam(refMap, "name");
438         if (isEmpty(name))
439            throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_PARAMS), "Missing ref.name for ref/prompt");
440         return McpCompletionRef.prompt(name);
441      }
442      if (eq(type, "ref/resource")) {
443         var uri = McpParamUtils.strParam(refMap, "uri");
444         if (isEmpty(uri))
445            throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_PARAMS), "Missing ref.uri for ref/resource");
446         return McpCompletionRef.resource(uri);
447      }
448      throw new McpException(errorCode(McpErrorKind.INVALID_PARAMS), "Invalid or missing ref.type: " + type);
449   }
